about: Which ledger files to delete because their account is no longer registered (spec flow-cli-core 1.2 'Removing an account'; flow usage prune, and DorkOS when an account is removed). Call pruneTargets(registered, onDisk). input.registered maps each runtime to its accounts' LEDGER ids (accounts.cases.json ledgerId, rev 6d): a routable row's id, and 'default' only while default stands alone (for Claude Code and Codex: no routable row has the default folder; for OpenCode: no registered row). An aliased default adds no id: its readings live in its row's file. input.onDisk maps each runtime to the ids that have a <id>.json ledger file. A missing runtime reads as []. expected.remove maps every runtime (claude-code, codex, opencode) to the ids to delete, in onDisk order: every id on disk that is not in registered for that runtime. So default.json stays while default stands alone, and goes once default is an alias (it would be a second reading of the row's account) or, for OpenCode, once the runtime has registered accounts. A file is deleted under its lock; a missing file is not an error.
